/gnu-projects/statetrace.title: DFA & NFA Simulator | StateTrace Finite Automata Tool
/gnu-projects/statetrace.description: Draw finite-state machines and simulate DFA and NFA input strings with step-by-step transition tracing, visual execution, and acceptance results.
/gnu-projects/statetrace.heading: StateTrace: Interactive DFA & NFA Simulator
/gnu-projects/statetrace.imageAlt: StateTrace tracing an input string through an NFA state diagram

sections.heading: Explore finite-state machines
sections.text: Build a DFA or NFA, enter an input string, and trace how the machine processes each symbol.

sections.heading: Draw a state machine
sections.text: Add states and transitions on the canvas, mark the start state and the accepting states, and label each transition with input symbols or an ε-move. Diagrams export as PNG, SVG, LaTeX, or JSON.

sections.heading: Trace an input string
sections.text: Run the finite automaton on any input and step forwards or backwards. StateTrace highlights the current state of a DFA, or every active state of an NFA, along with the transition being taken, the consumed and remaining input, and whether the string is accepted or rejected.

sections.heading: DFA and NFA support
sections.text: StateTrace detects whether a diagram is a deterministic or a nondeterministic finite automaton, including NFAs with ε-transitions, and follows all branches of an NFA at once. Pushdown automata and Turing machines are not simulated.
